errors.text: The required SRO finite-size boundary is not reconstructed: the target uses a 12x12x12, 3456-atom supercell, whereas the hypothesis only proposes an unspecified cell larger than 100 atoms.

FEP is incorrectly described as sampling along a coupling parameter; that is characteristic of thermodynamic integration. FEP instead depends on exponential averaging of MTP-to-DFT energy differences and therefore requires small energy-difference variance and strong phase-space overlap.
The hypothesis implies that a ground-state-trained MTP can retain electronic-excitation effects, although these require an explicit finite-electronic-temperature free-energy treatment or correction.
